LIVE THINGS TO TRY:

· The Find Your Discipline coverflow — drag it, flick it, click a card or a dot, or use the arrows. It also turns on its own (speed is a tweak chip above the artboard).
· Hover the gold words in the We'll See You At The Top paragraph — small preview cards pop up, homepage only.
· Any Request button opens the popup lead form.
· Sections fade in as you scroll.

This artboard is one long page — the homepage top to bottom. Fonts are back to Bebas Neue + Montserrat. Gold class names sit under the headline again (MMA · Jiu Jitsu · Boxing · Muay Thai · Youth Martial Arts). Phone replaces the get-in-touch email in the top bar. Gold gradients tint several section backgrounds. Pictures carry the same 8px corner as the buttons.
